title: CargoMatch — Groupage Handling
disclosures: Photorealistic AI-generated illustrative footage; physical handling is not software functionality or a filmed customer operation.
Authentic synthetic CargoMatch demo. Customs, payments and release are simulated. Delivery preference is not a transport booking; arrangements remain separate.

narration.en: A shared container can carry several different journeys, each with its own receiver, its own documents and its own next step.
narration.nl: Eén gedeelde container, meerdere reizen: elk met een eigen ontvanger, documenten en vervolgstap.

narration.en: In the CargoMatch demo, a groupage shipment travels from Mumbai, through Rotterdam, towards Tilburg, bringing smaller consignments into one consolidation.
narration.nl: In de CargoMatch-demo reizen deelzendingen in één consolidatie van Mumbai via Rotterdam naar Tilburg.

narration.en: For David, the forwarder, the master dossier provides the shared context, while the individual house shipments keep each receiver's business distinct.
narration.nl: Forwarder David ziet de masterconsolidatie. Afzonderlijke housedossiers houden de zendingen gescheiden.

narration.en: That distinction matters long before the container is opened, because a shared voyage does not mean that every partner should see every document.
narration.nl: Die scheiding telt al vóór het lossen: samen reizen betekent niet dat iedereen elk document mag zien.

narration.en: The receiver follows only their own house shipment, with the information their role permits, rather than another company's commercial details.
narration.nl: De ontvanger ziet alleen de eigen house-zending en toegestane informatie, niet de zaken van een ander.

narration.en: Within that dossier, the team can review the available documents and check what needs attention before the shipment moves further along the chain.
narration.nl: In het dossier controleert het team documenten en aandachtspunten voor de volgende stap.

narration.en: The documents support human review; they do not replace the judgement of the people responsible for the shipment and its requirements.
narration.nl: Documenten ondersteunen menselijke controle. Ze vervangen het oordeel van verantwoordelijke medewerkers niet.

narration.en: The same care applies to the costs, where the receiver sees relevant charges for their own shipment rather than the business of the whole consolidation.
narration.nl: Ook bij kosten ziet de ontvanger relevante posten voor de eigen zending, niet de hele consolidatie.

narration.en: Customs and release conditions need their own attention too, and the demonstration keeps those steps clearly separate from a real declaration or payment.
narration.nl: Douane en vrijgave vragen eigen controles. De demo blijft gescheiden van echte aangiften en betalingen.

narration.en: Here, those processes are simulated, so the team can understand the outstanding conditions without moving real money or claiming a real customs release.
narration.nl: Deze processen zijn gesimuleerd: inzicht in open voorwaarden, zonder echt geld of echte douanevrijgave.

narration.en: At the warehouse, the shared load becomes separate consignments again, with physical handling and checks preparing each shipment for its own onward journey.
narration.nl: In het magazijn worden deelzendingen gescheiden en gecontroleerd voor hun eigen vervolgtraject.

narration.en: The receiver can register a delivery preference in the dossier, giving the forwarder a clear indication of what is needed next.
narration.nl: De ontvanger legt een aflevervoorkeur vast. Zo weet de forwarder wat hierna nodig is.

narration.en: That choice is not a transport booking; availability, arrangements and the final handover still need to be agreed separately by the people involved.
narration.nl: Die keuze is geen transportboeking. Beschikbaarheid, afspraken en overdracht worden afzonderlijk afgestemd.

narration.en: From a shared container to an individual delivery, CargoMatch keeps the shipment story connected while respecting the boundaries around each receiver.
narration.nl: Van gedeelde container tot eigen aflevering: CargoMatch verbindt de reis en bewaakt de grenzen per ontvanger.

narration.en: Discover CargoMatch, the transport capacity intelligence network.
narration.nl: Ontdek CargoMatch, het netwerk voor transportcapaciteitsinformatie.
